STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE **1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS** - **No Inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML. - **Class/ID Selectors Only:** every visual property is applied via classes/IDs defined in `style.css`. - **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and style-agnostic — reskinning the page must require editing `style.css` only. Decorative effects (tails, bursts, halftones) must be pseudo-elements/gradients, never extra markup. **1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens** Define in `:root` (light "Paper" theme); override for dark per §1.3. - **Colors:** `--primary: #000000`, `--secondary: #1A1A1A`, `--bg-primary: #fefefe`, `--bg-secondary: #f5f5f5`, `--text-primary: #000000`, `--text-secondary: #444444`, `--text-success: #1E6B34`, `--text-error: #B3261E`, `--border-default: #000000`, `--border-error: #B3261E`, `--border-success: #1E6B34`, `--screentone: #CCCCCC`. - **Contrast Pairing:** every light background token pairs with dark text and vice versa — enforced in BOTH themes. Dark overrides: `--bg-primary: #111111`, `--bg-secondary: #1c1c1c`, `--text-primary: #fefefe`, `--text-secondary: #c9c9c9`, `--border-default: #fefefe`, `--primary: #fefefe`, `--screentone: #4a4a4a`, `--text-success: #63D67A`, `--text-error: #FF7A70`. All text/background pairs must pass 4.5:1. - **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 2px`, `--radius-md: 4px`, `--radius-lg: 28px` (speech bubbles), `--shadow-sm: 3px 3px 0 0 var(--primary)`, `--shadow-md: 6px 6px 0 0 var(--primary)` — hard comic offset shadows, NO blur; in dark mode shadows flip to a visible light ink (`#555555`). - **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 120ms`, `--transition-normal: 250ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`. - **Elevation/Stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 1000`, `--z-toast: 2000` — layered components must never collide. - **Theme extras:** `--panel-clip: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 95% 100%, 5% 100%)`, `--font-display`, `--font-body`, `--font-sfx` (see §1.6). **1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode — "Inverted Ink"** - Provide dark tokens under BOTH `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` (no-JS/first-paint fallback) and explicit `.theme-dark` / `.theme-light` classes on `` declared AFTER the media query so a class always wins. - **Persistence:** store the choice in `localStorage` (key `panel-one-theme`); first visit falls back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Theme resolution must be the first logic executed in `script.js`. - **Toggle:** visible header button with a Material Symbols icon (`light_mode` / `dark_mode`), `aria-pressed="true"` when dark, and an `aria-label` reflecting the action ("Switch to Inverted Ink theme" / "Switch to Paper theme"). Set the `color-scheme` property accordingly. - Halftone dots, speed lines, shadows, and focus rings must invert cleanly — no element may become invisible in dark mode. **1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment** - Build all layout with Flexbox (Tailwind `flex` utilities or CSS `display: flex`). - **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` (`items-center`) unless a section explicitly justifies an exception (e.g., `stretch` for equal-height pricing cards — document each exception in a CSS comment). - **Mobile-Friendly First:** single-column below 768px; multi-column at ≥768px/≥1024px; fluid `clamp()` typography; zero horizontal scrolling from 320px up. **1.5 Framework & Naming Convention** - Use **Tailwind CSS (Play CDN)** for layout utilities ONLY (`flex`, `items-center`, `gap-*`, `px-*`, responsive prefixes). Tailwind color utilities are forbidden — every color, border, shadow, and font comes from CSS variables via component classes in `style.css`. - **Single component convention: BEM** (`.panel`, `.panel__title`, `.btn`, `.btn--primary`, `.faq__item`, `.card--featured`); state classes `.is-loading`, `.is-open`. Never mix conventions; never invent non-BEM custom classes. **1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)** - One Google Fonts link: `Bangers` (display), `Comic Neue` 400/700 (body), `Permanent Marker` (SFX). Bind `--font-display: 'Bangers', 'Comic Neue', sans-serif`, `--font-body: 'Comic Neue', sans-serif`, `--font-sfx: 'Permanent Marker', cursive`. - Include the Google **Material Symbols Outlined** stylesheet; icons render via `name`. Filled stars via `font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 1`. - **Forbidden:** inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji-as-icons, raster images. ALL artwork (speed lines, bursts, halftones, tails) is CSS-only. --- ## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS **2.1 Buttons — `.btn`** - **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; 2px solid `var(--border-default)`; `var(--shadow-sm)`; uppercase letter-spaced display font. Variants: `.btn--primary` (ink fill, paper text), `.btn--secondary` (paper fill, ink border), `.btn--danger` (error-token fill/border, distinct in BOTH themes). - **Hover:** shadow grows to `--shadow-md` with a 1px lift; `cursor: pointer`. - **Focus:** `:focus-visible` ring — `outline: 3px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px` — visible on every background in both themes. - **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)` with shadow collapse. - **Loading (`.is-loading`):** pointer events disabled, double-clicks blocked, label swaps to a spinning Material `progress` icon (CSS rotation) WITHOUT changing button dimensions. - **Disabled (`[disabled]`):** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. - **Success/Error:** `.btn--success` / `.btn--danger` feedback styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`. **2.2 Cards — `.card` (Manga Panels)** - **Default:** flexbox layout, `--bg-secondary` fill, 2–3px solid border, `--shadow-sm`; optional `clip-path: var(--panel-clip)` on decorative variants. - **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + shadow grows to `--shadow-md`. - **Focus-within:** border highlight/ring when a child link or button receives focus. - **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer sweep (animated gradient), stable dimensions, no layout jump; disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`. - **Empty State:** `.card--empty` — centered Material icon + one-line guidance text. **2.3 Forms & Inputs — `.input-group`** - **Structure:** flex column wrapping `
